<!-- pr-reviewer: c62487ae9bbe4a5a4ec33833a5c82b741bbc2c60 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (stacked on #719, see notes).

**What looks good**
- Thin MCP wrapper over the existing `RepairModel` command: one undo step through the document History, validation at command construction, refusals reuse the command's own text, wrong JSON types refused by name.
- No unwrap/expect/panic or unchecked casts in `crates/app/src/mcp/model_tools.rs` (`usize::try_from` on the count).
- Pinning tests cover the success path with undo/redo and the refusal cases (nothing enters history). Decision record present, body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #717`, no PNG/CHANGELOG edits, no build.rs/.github/scripts/dependency changes.

**Local results (trial-merged with upstream/main 3b3d8081, merges cleanly)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_model`: 5 passed
- `--test mcp`: 13 passed; `--test repair_model`: 4 passed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- This branch carries #719's commits (`move_model`), which is still open. Merging #719 first, as the author says, keeps this PR's diff to its own change; merging this one first would land both.
- Provenance and file sizes are fine (new files 144 and 333 lines).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
